text: dsh-skill-router 是一个面向 DSH 的技能语义路由插件。它在 agent 每步处理前读取用户消息，将任务文本转换为向量，与技能名称、描述和适用说明的索引比较，再挑选相关技能并把完整内容追加到提示中。插件会随技能变更同步索引，并为每个 agent 避免重复注入同一技能；匹配规则、阈值和最多注入数可配置。适合希望 DSH 根据当前任务自动带入技能说明的用户。无需 API 密钥；首次使用会下载本地嵌入模型。

dsh-skill-router matches DSH tasks to relevant skills, then adds selected skill content to the prompt. It refreshes its index when skills change and avoids duplicate injection per agent. Selection settings are configurable. No API key is needed; the local embedding model downloads on first use.
希望 DSH 能根据当前任务自动找出该用的技能并附上说明。
让 agent 从技能库里挑选和用户请求最相关的几项。
Can DSH automatically load the most relevant skill instructions for each task?
技能按任务语义自动注入：在 agent 步骤前对用户文本做嵌入并与技能索引匹配，选中项的完整内容会追加到提示消息中。
技能变化后同步索引：监听技能变更事件，在后续步骤重新读取技能快照并更新索引，便于路由使用变更后的技能说明。

dsh-skill-router README · A Skill Router for DeepSeek Harness：RAG-style skill routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: embeds skills (their
`name + description + whenToUse` routing surface), embeds each user task, keeps
only the clearly-relevant skills with a gap-based selection rule, and
auto-injects their full bodies into the prompt — no model round-trip to load a
skill.

dsh-skill-router README · A Skill Router for DeepSeek Harness：- **Design**: see [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).
- **Status**: V1 complete and running — type-checks against the real DSH
  `0.1.5-rc.2` types, builds, mounts in a live DSH profile (verified in the
  web and headless profiles), and passes 20/24 bilingual routing prompts on
  real skills (`node demo/e2e.ts`). Compatible with DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` through
  `0.2.0-rc.2` (peer range `>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`); all routing APIs it uses —
  `ctx.skills.snapshot/get`, `skills/change`, `renderSkillContent`,
  `createUserMessage`, and the `agent/pre-step` middleware — are unchanged in
  `0.2.0-rc.2`.

text:
dsh-skill-router README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-router
```

Installs into the `web` profile; swap `web` for another profile name to target
it. Requires [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) and pnpm on
`PATH`.

dsh-skill-router README · Install：> **pnpm 12 build approval** — the first install pulls native dependencies
> (`onnxruntime-node`, `sharp`, `protobufjs`) whose build scripts pnpm blocks by
> default. If `dsh plugin` stops with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`, open
> `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/pnpm-workspace.yaml`, set the `allowBuilds` entries
> pnpm wrote there to `true`, then re-run the same `dsh plugin ... add` command.
>
> The first real task downloads the embedding model once (~543MB, q8) into
> `$DSH_HOME/skill-router/models`, then runs fully offline.

dsh-skill-router README · Layout：- `src/index.ts` — the Cordis plugin entry (`name` / `inject` / `Config` / `apply`).
- `src/selection.ts` — the selection rule (largest-gap / ratio-to-max, weak floor).
- `src/similarity.ts` — cosine similarity + vector helpers (pure).
- `src/embedding.ts` — one real embedding model via transformers.js (ONNX).
- `src/skillIndex.ts` — the index: build, embed, digest-diff sync on change.
- `src/config.ts` — schemastery config schema + mappers.
- `src/render.ts` — renders the injected `<system-reminder>` block (reuses DSH's `renderSkillContent`).
- `demo/e2e.ts` — end-to-end routing test over downloaded skills.

dsh-skill-router README · Build：```sh
npm install        # toolchain (typescript, esbuild); DSH types come from a local checkout symlink
npm run typecheck  # tsc --noEmit against the real DSH types
npm run build      # esbuild -> lib/index.js (@deepseek-ai/* kept external)
```

dsh-skill-router README · Demo：Skills live in `.agents/skills/` — a real DSH scanned root (rank 200, see
DESIGN.md §14). The demo parses them the same way the registry would surface
them:

```sh
node demo/e2e.ts           # plugin defaults
node demo/e2e.ts 0.2       # experiment with the minScore floor
```

dsh-skill-router README · Config (defaults)：```yaml
enabled: true
embedding:
  model: Xenova/bge-m3                          # optional; any HF ONNX embedding model
  dtype: q8                                     # or fp32

The plugin default above is classic gap/ratio mode. The bundled
`cordis.patch.yml` ships with the scale-invariant override instead:
`minScore: 0.05` and `zThreshold: 2.5`.

dsh-skill-router README · Languages：Chinese and English both work out of the box — the default model is
multilingual, and a Chinese prompt matches an English skill description (and
vice versa) by meaning, cross-lingual. One DSH registry rule to respect:
skill **names** must stay kebab-case ASCII (`pdf-tools`), but `description`,
`whenToUse`, and the body can be Chinese. The injected instruction block is
bilingual (中文/English).

dsh-skill-router README · Embedding model：One engine: a real local model via transformers.js (ONNX) — dense semantic
vectors; synonyms and paraphrases match, word sharing is not required.
Default `Xenova/bge-m3` (q8, ~543MB download, 1024-dim, [CLS] pooling) —
flagship multilingual quality for Chinese + English. Alternatives via
`embedding.model`: `multilingual-e5-small` (fast, needs query/passage
prefixes — handled automatically), `bge-large-en-v1.5`, `bge-large-zh-v1.5`.

dsh-skill-router README · Embedding model：Scoring de-biases the vectors by subtracting the corpus mean ("centering"),
which removes the shared direction that would otherwise make unrelated texts
score ~0.8. Inference is pinned to a single thread so results are
deterministic.

dsh-skill-router README · Embedding model：All heavy data lives OUTSIDE the working directory: the model downloads once
from huggingface.co into `<cacheDir>/models`, and the skill-embedding index
persists at `<cacheDir>/skill-index.json` (atomic writes, tagged with the
model id), so unchanged skills are never re-embedded after a restart.

dsh-skill-router README · Dev note：`node_modules/@deepseek-ai` and `node_modules/js-yaml` are local symlinks into
a DSH checkout for type-checking and demos; recreate them after a fresh
install. At runtime a real DSH profile provides the `@deepseek-ai/*` packages
(they are declared as `peerDependencies` and kept external by the build).
